instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Publish one file from a folder I choose on my computer at my server's download address", and give it hostname; address; ssh_port (The server's SSH port (22 for a pinned key written as "<address> ssh-ed25519 <key>")); admin_user (The administrator the run signs in as); knownHost; host; file (A relative path inside the folder granted to this tool, such as builds/App-1.dmg.); name (The public download name that points to the immutable kept file.).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:publish-a-download and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads one relative file path inside the folder I grant, sends it to my rented server over pinned SSH through this run's proxy, and moves the public download pointer only after the server confirms that the kept bytes match.
